project.name: AI Seller Risk Intelligence System
project.purpose: Identify seller patterns associated with future delivery and review risk.

evaluation.calibration_status: Scores should not be interpreted as well-calibrated literal probabilities

delivery.not_for: High-confidence automated decisions or guaranteed predictions
delivery.reason: Random Forest had the highest test ROC-AUC among the evaluated delivery models, but performance remained close to random ranking.

review.production_use: Prioritize sellers for review and investigation
review.not_for: Automatic punitive decisions or guaranteed predictions
review.reason: Logistic Regression achieved the strongest out-of-time ranking performance among the evaluated review-risk models.

delivery.purpose: Identify sellers that may require delivery-performance monitoring.
delivery.recommended_action: Investigate delivery trends, late-order behavior, and operational performance.

review.purpose: Prioritize sellers whose patterns are associated with future review risk.
review.recommended_action: Review customer feedback, seller experience indicators, and recent operational changes.

limitations: Review-risk performance is stronger, but precision remains relatively low.
Temporal changes in the data may cause future model performance to drift.
Model coefficients and SHAP values describe model behavior and associations, not causation.
Predictions should be treated as screening or monitoring signals rather than guarantees.
The final test period was not used for training or threshold selection.
